english.heading: Food Forest Design
body: Build a living food system in layers.
Grow food from tall canopy down to root crops.
Use vertical space, soil life, shade, and moisture together.
Learn how to design and establish a food forest for your farm.

body.text: Yakha inkqubo yokutya ephilayo ngemigangatho.
Lima ukutya ukusuka kwisithsaba somthi ophakamileyo ukuya kwizityalo ezingcambu.
Sebenzisa indawo ethe nkqo, ubomi bomhlaba, umthunzi nokufuma kunye.
Funda ukuyila nokuseka ihlathi lokutya kwifama yakho.

english.heading: Why This Matters
body: A food forest grows useful plants at different heights.
Good design can combine harvests, shade and soil cover. Plants still compete for light, water and nutrients.
Plan the care you can provide and watch how the planting changes.

body.text: Ihlathi lokutya likhulisa izityalo eziluncedo ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo zobude.
Uyilo olulungileyo lunokudibanisa izivuno, umthunzi nesigqubuthelo somhlaba. Izityalo zisakhuphisana ngokukhanya, amanzi nezondlo.
Cwangcisa inkathalo onokuyinika uze ujonge indlela ukutyala okutshintsha ngayo.

english.heading: Learning Outcomes
body: Name the seven commonly described food-forest layers.
Check plants against your site, local ecology and the approved project list.
Plan establishment and ongoing care without assuming a fixed date for harvest or canopy closure.

body.text: Zibize ngamagama imigangatho esixhenxe echazwa rhoqo yehlathi lokutya.
Hlola izityalo ngokuhambelana nendawo yakho, indalo yasekuhlaleni noluhlu lweprojekthi olwamkelweyo.
Cwangcisa ukusekwa nenkathalo eqhubekayo ngaphandle kokucinga umhla othile wesivuno okanye wokuvaleka kwesithsaba.

english.heading: The Forest Uses Every Layer
body: An indigenous forest fills the space from the highest branches to the roots.
Different plants use the light and moisture available at their level.
A food forest copies this pattern with productive species.
The result is not one crop in one row, but many useful layers growing together.

body.text: Ihlathi lomdabu lizalisa indawo ukusuka kumasebe aphezulu ukuya kwiingcambu.
Izityalo ezahlukeneyo zisebenzisa ukukhanya nokufuma okukhoyo kumgangatho wazo.
Ihlathi lokutya liyayixelisa le ndlela ngezityalo ezivelisayo.
Isiphumo asiyiyo isityalo esinye kumqolo omnye, kodwa yimigangatho emininzi eluncedo ekhula ndawonye.

english.heading: Watch: Read the Seven Planting Layers
body: Find seven planting layers.
Tall trees form the canopy.
Smaller trees grow below it.
Then look for woody shrubs.
Herbaceous plants have soft stems.
Ground cover spreads across the surface.
Root crops grow below the surface.
Climbers use suitable supports.
These are planning layers, not fixed height bands. Choose plants and spacing for your site.

body.text: Fumana imigangatho esixhenxe yokutyala.
Imithi emide yenza isithsaba.
Imithi emincinci ikhula ngaphantsi kwaso.
Emva koko khangela amatyholo anomthi.
Izityalo ezingenamthi zinemiqu ethambileyo.
Izityalo ezigubungela umhlaba zisasazeka kumphezulu.
Izityalo ezingcambu zikhula ngaphantsi komphezulu.
Izityalo ezinyukayo zisebenzisa izixhasi ezifanelekileyo.
Le yimigangatho yocwangciso, ayizizo iibhanti zobude ezimiselweyo. Khetha izityalo nokwahlukana kwazo ngokwendawo yakho.

english.heading: The Seven Layers
body: Think of tall canopy, smaller trees, shrubs and herbaceous plants.
Ground cover protects the surface, root crops grow below it, and climbers use suitable supports.
The heights and spacing depend on the plants and site. These are planning layers, not fixed height bands.

body.text: Cinga ngesithsaba somthi esiphakamileyo, imithi emincinci, amatyholo nezityalo ezingenamthi ezithambileyo.
Izityalo ezigubungela umhlaba ziwukhusela ngaphezulu, izityalo ezingcambu zikhula ngaphantsi kwawo, kwaye izityalo ezinyukayo zisebenzisa izixhasi ezifanelekileyo.
Ubude nokwahlukana kwezityalo kuxhomekeke kwizityalo nakwindawo. Le yimigangatho yocwangciso, ayizizo iibhanti zobude ezimiselweyo.

english.heading: Read a Layered Planting Example
body: The original Highveld example includes Wild Fig or pecan above lemon, naartjie and black mulberry.
It places Cape gooseberry and Wild Medlar with vegetables, wild garlic, sweet potato and granadilla.
Treat this as a layout example, not permission to plant every species. Check identity, frost tolerance, mature size and local restrictions first.

body.text: Umzekelo wokuqala we-Highveld uquka i-Wild Fig okanye i-pecan ngaphezu kwe-lemon, i-naartjie ne-black mulberry.
Ubeka i-Cape gooseberry ne-Wild Medlar kunye nemifuno, i-wild garlic, ubhatata ne-granadilla.

Thatha oku njengomzekelo wocwangciso, hayi imvume yokutyala zonke iintlobo. Qala ngokuqinisekisa ukuba sisiphi isityalo, ukumelana neqabaka, ubungakanani xa sele sikhulile, nezithintelo zasekuhlaleni.

english.heading: Care Changes as Plants Grow
body: Young plants need establishment care: moisture checks, weed control and protection from damage.
As plants grow, shade and leaf litter change conditions below them.
Check competition and access. Prune, thin or adjust lower planting when observations call for it; the system does not become care-free on a fixed birthday.

body.text: Izityalo ezincinci zidinga ukunyanyekelwa ekusekweni kwazo: ukuhlola ukufuma, ukulawula ukhula nokukhuselwa ekonzakaleni.
Njengoko izityalo zikhula, umthunzi namagqabi awileyo ayaguqula iimeko ezingaphantsi kwazo.

Hlola ukukhuphisana nendlela yokufikelela. Sika, nciphisa okanye hlengahlengisa ukutyala kwemigangatho engaphantsi xa oko ukubonayo kufuna; inkqubo ayiphelelwa kukudinga ukunyanyekelwa ngomhla othile omiselweyo.

english.heading: Choose for Your Site
body: Check local rainfall, frost, heat, soil and water availability before choosing plants.
Mango can suffer frost damage. Quince needs suitable winter chilling for reliable cropping.
A regional label or a sheltered corner is not enough. Confirm each plant and variety with reliable local guidance.

body.text: Hlola imvula, iqabaka, ubushushu, umhlaba nokufumaneka kwamanzi kwindawo yakho ngaphambi kokukhetha izityalo.
I-mango inokonakaliswa liqabaka. I-quince idinga ubusika obubandayo ngokufanelekileyo ukuze izale ngokuthembekileyo.
Igama lommandla okanye ikona ekhuselekileyo ayiyonto eyaneleyo. Qinisekisa isityalo ngasinye nohlobo ngalunye ngesikhokelo esithembekileyo sasekuhlaleni.

english.heading: Watch: Match the Species to the Climate
body: Climate decides which species belong.
On the Highveld, choose cold-tolerant trees and shrubs; on the KZN coast and Lowveld, choose warm-climate species.
Match every plant to your site.

body.text: Imozulu igqiba ukuba zeziphi iintlobo ezifanelekileyo.
EHighveld, khetha imithi namatyholo anyamezela ukubanda; elunxwemeni lwe-KZN nase-Lowveld, khetha iintlobo zeendawo ezishushu.
Dibanisa isityalo ngasinye nendawo yakho.

english.heading: Check the Highveld Examples
body: The original list includes pecan, walnut and indigenous fig; apple, pear, plum, black mulberry and loquat; rosemary, Wild Medlar, Cape gooseberry and Barbados cherry.
This list is not a blanket recommendation. Check each plant against frost, soil, mature size and the approved local species list.
Keep existing legal and project restrictions in force. Do not plant from a picture alone.

body.text: Uluhlu lokuqala luquka pecan, walnut nekhiwane lomdabu; apple, pear, plum, black mulberry ne-loquat; rosemary, Wild Medlar, Cape gooseberry ne-Barbados cherry.
Olu luhlu aluyiyo ingcebiso yazo zonke. Hlola isityalo ngasinye ngokuhambelana neqabaka, umhlaba, ubungakanani xa sele sikhulile noluhlu lweentlobo ezivunyiweyo zasekuhlaleni.
Gcina izithintelo ezikhoyo zomthetho nezeprojekthi zisebenza. Ungatyali ngokubona ifoto kuphela.

english.heading: Check the Warm-Region Examples
body: The original warm-region examples include mango, avocado, Natal Mahogany, banana, pawpaw, litchi, Wild Fig, Barbados cherry and Wild Dagga.
Marula, Mopane and baobab also appear in the Limpopo examples. Local suitability still needs checking.
Useful trees are not automatically edible. Confirm identity and safe use; a landscape photograph is not a food-identification guide.

body.text: Imizekelo yokuqala yeendawo ezishushu iquka mango, avocado, Natal Mahogany, banana, pawpaw, litchi, Wild Fig, Barbados cherry ne-Wild Dagga.
Marula, Mopane ne-baobab nazo zivela kwimizekelo yaseLimpopo. Ukufaneleka kwindawo yakho kusafuna ukuhlolwa.
Imithi eluncedo ayizizo ngokuzenzekelayo ezityiwayo. Qinisekisa ukuba sisiphi isityalo nokusetyenziswa kwaso ngokukhuselekileyo; ifoto yembonakalo yomhlaba ayisosikhokelo sokuchonga ukutya.

english.heading: Include Locally Appropriate Indigenous Plants
body: Locally appropriate indigenous plants can support habitat as part of the design.
Choose for your ecosystem and the useful role of each plant. There is no sourced percentage target in this lesson.
Protect existing natural vegetation. Do not turn healthy grassland into a food forest simply because trees are useful elsewhere.

body.text: Izityalo zomdabu ezifanelekileyo kwindawo zinokuxhasa indawo yokuhlala yezilwanyana zasendle njengenxalenye yoyilo.
Khetha ngokwendalo yendawo yakho nangendima eluncedo yesityalo ngasinye. Akukho njongo yepesenti esekelwe kumthombo othembekileyo kwesi sifundo.
Khusela izityalo zendalo ezikhoyo. Musa ukuguqula amathafa aphilileyo abe lihlathi lokutya ngenxa nje yokuba imithi iluncedo kwenye indawo.

english.heading: Plan the Sequence for the Site
body: Start by checking the site, water supply and care available. Protect exposed soil early.
Temporary support plants may provide shelter and useful cut material where appropriate.
Main trees and lower layers can be introduced as conditions allow. Ground cover need not wait until the end; avoid plants competing with young trees.

body.text: Qala ngokuhlola indawo, unikezelo lwamanzi nokhathalelo olukhoyo. Khusela umhlaba ongagqunyiwe kwangoko.
Izityalo zenkxaso zethutyana zinokunika indawo yokukhuselwa nezinto eziluncedo ezisikiweyo apho kufanelekileyo.

Imithi ephambili nemigangatho esezantsi inokufakwa njengoko iimeko zivuma. Izityalo ezigubungela umhlaba akuyomfuneko ukuba zilinde de kube sekupheleni; phepha ukuba izityalo zikhuphisane nemithi emincinci.

english.heading: Watch: Care for a Young Food Forest
body: This picture shows a young food forest. Start with an area you can care for.
Protect exposed soil early. Here, loose mulch covers the soil.
Keep mulch away from the trunk. Notice the clear space at the tree's base.
Watch for competition. The farmer is removing grass near the young tree.
Before adding more plants, check moisture, shelter and the care you can provide. Let what you observe guide your next step.

body.text: Esi sithombe sibonisa ihlathi lokutya eselula. Qala ngendawo onokuyikhathalela.
Khusela umhlaba ongagqunyiwe kwangoko. Apha, ingca yokugquma ekhululekileyo igubungela umhlaba.
Gcina ingca yokugquma ikude nesiqu. Qaphela indawo ecocekileyo esiqwini somthi.
Qaphela ukukhuphisana. Umfama uyasusa ingca ecaleni komthi oselula.
Phambi kokongeza izityalo ezininzi, hlola ukufuma, indawo ekhuselekileyo nenkathalo onokuyinika. Vumela oko ukubonayo kukhokele inyathelo olilandelayo.

english.heading: Prepare a Manageable First Area
body: Begin with an area you can water and maintain. Check existing vegetation before clearing.
Where appropriate, plain cardboard under suitable mulch can suppress unwanted growth. Keep water able to enter the soil and leave trunks clear.
Plan spacing from mature plant size. Prepare nursery plants for the next suitable planting opportunity.

body.text: Qala ngendawo onokuyinkcenkceshela uyigcine. Hlola izityalo ezikhoyo ngaphambi kokucoca.
Apho kufanelekileyo, ikhadibhodi eqhelekileyo phantsi kwengca yokugquma efanelekileyo inganciphisa ukukhula okungafunwayo. Gcina amanzi anokungena emhlabeni uzishiye iziqu zemithi zicocekile.
Cwangcisa ukwahlukana ngokobungakanani bezityalo xa sele zikhulile. Lungiselela izityalo zasenkulisweni (i-nursery) kwithuba elilandelayo elifanelekileyo lokutyala.

english.heading: Adjust as the Trees Grow
body: Watch how shade, roots and available water affect neighbouring plants.
Comfrey and wild garlic appear in the original underplanting example; check their local suitability before use.
Prune or thin support plants when needed, using methods suited to each species. Suitable clean cuttings can return as mulch. Do not wait for a fixed year if competition is already harming plants.

body.text: Khangela indlela umthunzi, iingcambu namanzi akhoyo achaphazela ngayo izityalo ezingabamelwane.
I-comfrey ne-wild garlic zivela kumzekelo wokuqala wokutyala ngaphantsi; hlola ukufaneleka kwazo kwindawo yakho ngaphambi kokuzisebenzisa.

Sika okanye nciphisa izityalo zenkxaso xa kuyimfuneko, usebenzisa iindlela ezifanelekileyo kuhlobo ngalunye. Izinqumlo ezicocekileyo ezifanelekileyo zinokubuyela njengengca yokugquma. Ungalindi unyaka othile omiselweyo ukuba ukukhuphisana sele kuzonakalisa izityalo.

english.heading: Plant with Reliable Moisture
body: Choose a planting opportunity when soil moisture and expected weather support establishment.
Rain can help, but check the root zone and keep a backup watering plan. Avoid planting into waterlogged ground.
Check young plants after planting. Harvest timing and outside inputs depend on the species, site and care; there is no guaranteed fifth-year result.

body.text: Khetha ithuba lokutyala xa ukufuma komhlaba nemozulu elindelekileyo zixhasa ukusekwa.
Imvula inganceda, kodwa hlola indawo yeengcambu kwaye uhlale unesicwangciso sokunkcenkceshela esilindileyo. Phepha ukutyala emhlabeni ozele ngamanzi.
Hlola izityalo ezincinci emva kokutyala. Ixesha lokuvuna nezinto ezongezwa zivela ngaphandle zixhomekeke kuhlobo lwesityalo, indawo nokhathalelo; akukho sivuno siqinisekisiweyo kunyaka wesihlanu.

english.heading: Field Assignment
body: Draw the layers for your own proposed planting. Mark access, water and existing natural vegetation.
Record local frost, rain, soil and available care.
For each plant from the approved list, record its intended role and the local advice still needed before planting.

body.text: Zoba imigangatho yokutyala okucetywayo kwakho. Phawula indlela yokufikelela, amanzi nezityalo zendalo ezikhoyo.
Rekhoda iqabaka, imvula, umhlaba nenkathalo ekhoyo kwindawo yakho.
Kwisityalo ngasinye esikuluhlu olwamkelweyo, rekhoda indima ekujoliswe kuyo nengcebiso yasekuhlaleni eseyimfuneko ngaphambi kokutyala.

english.heading: Field Action
body: Inspect a manageable area and choose one next step.
Protect exposed soil, check plant suitability, or prepare nursery plants.
Plant only when conditions and follow-up care are suitable. Return to the same spot to check survival, soil moisture and competition.

body.text: Hlola indawo elawulekayo ukhethe inyathelo elinye elilandelayo.
Khusela umhlaba ongagqunyiwe, hlola ukufaneleka kwesityalo, okanye ulungiselele izityalo zenkulisa.
Tyala kuphela xa iimeko nenkathalo elandelayo zifanelekile. Buyela kuloo ndawo uhlole ukusinda, ukufuma komhlaba nokukhuphisana.
